correctness.rationale: Every basis partner must represent all \(m\) restriction classes with exactly one repeated class; otherwise two independent column differences would be supported on only one row and force singularity. Subtracting the repeated columns reduces the determinant to an \(m\)-point Fourier determinant times one root-of-unity chord. The maximizing chord and the normalized asymptotic are then elementary and exact.
